personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Adapted for High Contrast Outdoor Utility)
personality_one_liner: Clean, rugged, and high-contrast—designed strictly for speed, large tap targets, and absolute readability in bright outdoor sunlight.

spacing.rule: Avoid cramped layouts. Due to gloves and outdoor usage, standard tap targets must be padded out to minimum 56pt. Use lg and xl for primary container margins.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary or brand tinted backgrounds instead of glass for max contrast.
dont's: Do not use blur/glass anywhere. Direct sunlight washes out glass overlays.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Command center featuring two massive quick-action buttons and today's vital metrics.

states.error: Card showing 'Failed to load summary' with a large 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Hero Section: 2 massive buttons (min 80pt height) 'Scan Plant' (Primary Brand color) and 'New Bill' side-by-side or stacked. Middle Section: 'Today' Summary grid (Sales in ₹, Bills, Items). Bottom: 'Low Stock' list displaying max 3 items with quick 'Restock' button.

screens.name: AI_Plant_Scanner
screens.purpose: Camera interface to identify plants via AI and immediately add to cart.

states.loading: Translucent overlay on camera with 'Analyzing leaf...' spinner.
states.error: Toast or modal: 'Could not identify plant' with 'Retake' or 'Manual Search' buttons.

screens.layout: Full screen camera. Safe area bottom has massive circular Shutter button. Once photo taken, Gorhom Bottom Sheet slides up with 'Plant Name', 'Confidence %', '₹ Price' and a massive 100% width 'Add to Cart' sticky button.

screens.name: Billing_Cart
screens.purpose: Review cart items and initiate checkout.

states.empty: Illustration of a potted plant + 'Cart is empty' + 'Scan Item' button.

screens.layout: Scrollable list of items. Each row uses large touch targets for +/- steppers. Sticky footer container at the bottom (anchored outside scroll) showing 'Total: ₹ XXX' and a massive 'Collect Payment' primary button.

screens.name: Payment
screens.purpose: Select payment mode and confirm transaction.
screens.layout: Displayed as a full-screen or large bottom sheet. Total amount huge at the top. Three vertically stacked, giant buttons (Cash, UPI, Card). Tapping one confirms the order immediately (minimum taps).

screens.name: Inventory
screens.layout: Large Search Bar at the top. Scrollable list of products. Each row has Product Image (left), Name/Price (center), Stock count (right in a chip). Red chip for low stock. Tap row to view Product Detail.

onboarding_hero.alt: Potted plants on metal tables in a sunlit garden nursery

ai_scanner_placeholder.alt: Detailed view of a variegated green leaf showcasing its intricate patterns and colors.

empty_state_cart.alt: green plant on white ceramic pot

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Design exclusively for bright sunlight and gloved hands. Do not use blur, thin borders, or low-contrast text. Use absolute max contrast (white bg, near-black text, dark green brand).
Use xl (20px) and 2xl (24px) font sizes for primary actions and labels to ensure older users can read them easily.
Bypass the 44pt touch target rule and aim for 56pt minimum height for all interactive elements (+/- steppers, list rows, action buttons) to accommodate gloved hands.
Maintain the bottom tabs exactly as requested by user: Home | Billing | Inventory | Customers | More.
Implement the sticky primary CTA over scrolling content rule religiously, especially for the 'Collect Payment' button in the Billing/Cart screen.
Use Phosphor icons. Ensure stroke weights are thick enough to be visible outdoors.
Research finding: POS systems need 'muscle memory'. Keep primary buttons (like 'Pay' and 'Add') in the exact same lower-third region across screens.
